title: Combat panel scrolls to its end on a phone
description: On a phone the space combat panel sits under the map and the page scrolls. The panel used to be a scroll box of its own inside that page scroll and had no room under its last card for the fixed Players / Events dock and the browser's bottom bar, so the lower content could not be reached. It is now one page scroll, and the panel ends with room for the dock, the browser bar and the home indicator. Each shot is scrolled as far down as it goes.

shots.heading: Before, 390x700 (browser bars showing)
shots.caption: Scrolled to the end: the panel's own scroll box and the page scroll fight, the header is half scrolled away, and the last card runs 43 px under the dock.

shots.heading: After, 390x700
shots.caption: One scroll. The last card ends 33 px above the dock, with the whole panel (attacker, odds, defender, status line) in reach.

shots.heading: Before, 360x640
shots.caption: Small phone with bars showing: the last card ends under the dock.

shots.heading: After, 360x640
shots.caption: The last card ends above the dock.

shots.heading: Before, 430x850
shots.caption: Taller phone, still a nested scroll box.

shots.heading: After, 430x850
shots.caption: Same panel, single scroll, clear of the dock.
